caption: Fig.1.6 The vapour pressures of two component systems as a function of composition (a) a solution that shows positive deviation from Raoult's law and (b) a solution that shows negative deviation from Raoult's law.
note: Caption is printed in italics down the left-hand side, 'Fig.1.6' in bold on its own line. Two panels (a) and (b), each carrying the same label set; the labels are listed panel by panel, top-left to bottom-right within each. All subscripts are printed as subscripts. The axis labels 'x1' and 'x2' below 'Mole fraction' each carry a printed direction arrow (x1 with an arrow to the right, x2 with an arrow to the left) which is a mark, not text. In panel (a) the curve labelled p1 is the left/lower one and p2 the right one; in panel (b) p2 is the left curve and p1 the right one.
